module_summary: Pipelined RISC-V multiplier: decodes MUL/MULH variants, registers sign-extended 33-bit operands, multiplies, selects high/low half and pipelines result over 2-3 stages under hold.

anchors.name: opcode_valid_i
anchors.why: Issue valid; with mult_inst_w loads E1 operand registers

anchors.name: opcode_opcode_i
anchors.why: Instruction word decoded for MUL variant and operand signedness

anchors.name: opcode_ra_operand_i
anchors.why: Source operand A, sign/zero extended into operand_a_r

anchors.name: opcode_rb_operand_i
anchors.why: Source operand B, sign/zero extended into operand_b_r

anchors.name: hold_i
anchors.why: Pipeline stall freezing operand and result registers

anchors.name: writeback_value_o
anchors.why: Multiply result from stage 2 or 3 register

anchors.name: mult_inst_w
anchors.why: Decoded any-multiply instruction flag enabling operand capture

anchors.name: operand_a_e1_q
anchors.why: Stage-1 33-bit operand A register feeding multiplier

anchors.name: operand_b_e1_q
anchors.why: Stage-1 33-bit operand B register feeding multiplier

anchors.name: mulhi_sel_e1_q
anchors.why: Selects high or low 32 bits of product

anchors.name: result_e2_q
anchors.why: Stage-2 result register, default writeback source

anchors.name: result_e3_q
anchors.why: Optional stage-3 result register when MULT_STAGES is 3

groups.name: Decode and operand prep
groups.description: Decodes multiply variant and sign-extends operands

groups.name: Stage 1 operand registers
groups.description: Captures operands and high/low select under hold
